data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract reserve movement figures from the provided scanned images. The report images are low-resolution/rotated and the key notes that would contain the gross prior year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, claims development table or explicit gross narrative) could not be unambiguously read.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned/rotated images at low resolution. I could read the total gross written premium for 2018 (945,963 reported in the statement table, i.e. 945.963 million GBP) on page labeled '4', but could not confidently extract gross claims outstanding (opening reserves), the GROSS prior year movement amount, or the segmental premium breakdown (gross_premium_mix). No unambiguous 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure or clear claims development triangle could be parsed from the images. Many numeric tables were partially legible but rotated and pixelated; therefore reserve movement fields are returned as null. If higher-resolution, correctly oriented PDF pages of the Technical Reserves / Notes (particularly the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note and the Claims Development Table) are supplied I can extract the requested values.
